cards.designNote: Efficient relay. Draw and NP in one activation.
cards.flavourText: Stacked memory cores glowing.

cards.name: Recursive Loop
cards.abilityText: Persistent: Draw 2 cards at the start of each turn.
cards.designNote: Premium card-draw engine. Game-warping if unanswered.
cards.flavourText: A self-referential spiral of repeating glyphs feeding back into itself.

cards.name: Feedback Protocol
cards.abilityText: Persistent: Give all allied active units +1 ATK at the start of each turn.
cards.designNote: Ongoing board-wide buff. Snowballs if not removed.
cards.flavourText: Control loop diagram come alive.

cards.name: Entanglement Specialist
cards.abilityText: Deploy: Draw 3 cards and gain 2 NP.
cards.designNote: Major refuel on deploy. Restocks hand and ramps.
cards.flavourText: Scientist between two linked particles mirroring each other across a gap.

cards.name: Mainframe Guardian
cards.abilityText: Piercing. Deploy: Debuff all enemy active units -2 ATK this turn.
cards.designNote: Top-end threat. Piercing plus board-wide debuff.
cards.flavourText: Armored custodian before a towering mainframe.

cards.name: Parallel Processor
cards.abilityText: Activate: Draw 2 cards.
cards.designNote: Repeatable deep draw. Must-answer engine.
cards.flavourText: A multi-core cluster processing simultaneous threads.

cards.name: Senior Researcher
cards.abilityText: Deploy: Give all allied active units +2 ATK permanently.
cards.designNote: Permanent board-wide buff. Game-changing deploy.
cards.flavourText: Distinguished lead scientist at a holo-table.

cards.name: Wavelength Disruptor
cards.abilityText: Deploy: Exhaust all enemy active units.
cards.designNote: Mass exhaust. Clears the way for an alpha strike.
cards.flavourText: Emitter throwing a dissonant wave that stalls every enemy system in its path.

cards.name: Learning Cycle
cards.abilityText: Draw 4 cards. Gain 2 NP.
cards.designNote: Massive hand refill plus NP. Turns the corner.
cards.flavourText: A neural network diagram brightening as it trains.

cards.name: System Override
cards.abilityText: Exhaust all enemy active units and prevent them from blocking this turn.
cards.designNote: Premium removal spell. Full board lockdown for one turn.
cards.flavourText: A red override glyph seizing control.

cards.name: Infinite Regression
cards.abilityText: Persistent: Draw 2 cards and gain 2 NP at the start of each turn.
cards.designNote: Ultimate ongoing engine. Must be removed immediately.
cards.flavourText: A fractal corridor of ever-repeating data.

cards.name: Dr. Lumen
cards.abilityText: Deploy: Draw 3 cards and gain 3 NP. Activate: Draw 1 card.
cards.designNote: FSTI legendary. Massive deploy value plus repeatable draw.
cards.flavourText: The institute's famed lead.

cards.name: Nexus Core
cards.abilityText: Persistent: Draw 3 cards, gain 3 NP, and give all allied active units +1 ATK at the start of each turn.
cards.designNote: FSTI ultimate protocol. Overwhelming recurring value.
cards.flavourText: A vast crystalline processing core.
